relationships.description: The sample value illustrates a concrete request or response payload, parameter value or header value exchanged when calling this specific HTTP method-path interaction.
relationships.evidence: The OpenAPI document places the example (inline or via $ref to components/examples) inside an examples map of a parameter, request body or response media type nested under that operation's path and method.

relationships.description: The sample value is an illustrative instance of the data shape defined by the schema, conforming to its type and structure without itself defining or constraining them.
relationships.evidence: The example sits in the same media type, parameter or header object whose schema property defines (inline or via $ref to components/schemas) the shape, and its value validates against that schema.

notes: In OpenAPI 3.0 an Example Object never points to a Schema; it is only co-located with one. 'references' is therefore an inferred link, not a pointer. 'associated-with' to operation is indirect, since it goes through a parameter, header or media type. A path via those elements may make both relationships redundant.
